name: spatial_query_anchors
description: Inspects geometric context, bounds, surface normals, and available sockets on target actors or zones.

target_actor.description: Actor label or name in the level to inspect (e.g. 'Floor_0', 'Corridor_DoorL', 'Cargo_WallA')

surface_type.description: Filter for specific surface orientations or sockets

tag_filter.description: Optional tag filter for reference points
